title: Structure case: from tall to flat, and analyse frame
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: structure case and analyse frame)
intro: Lesson 34. Read the case and the data, then plan your analysis.

passage.title: HomeHub Stores plc
paras: HomeHub Stores plc sells furniture and kitchenware in 150 large stores. Each store manager reports to one of 12 area managers, who report to 3 regional directors, who report to the operations director.
The board plans to remove the area-manager level. Store managers would report straight to the regional directors and would make more decisions themselves, such as staff rotas and local promotions.
passage.source: All businesses, people and figures in this case are fictional, made up for practice.

head: Now (tall)
Planned (flat)
rows: Time to approve a local promotion

blocks.h: Answer frame (6 marks: chains of reasoning in context)

blocks.text: Analyse the effects on HomeHub Stores of moving from a tall to a flat structure. (6 marks)

frame.label: Chain: because ... this leads to ... so ...
Chain: because ... this leads to ... so ...

markScheme.a: Removing 12 area managers on £50,000 cuts salary costs by £600,000 a year, so profit rises; communication and decisions are faster (3 weeks to 3 days), so promotions match local demand; store managers are empowered and more motivated. But each regional director now has a span of 50 stores, so may be overloaded and support for weak stores may fall. Level 3 (5-6): a balanced analysis with two developed chains of reasoning, both in context. Level 2 (3-4): developed reasoning, partly in context. Level 1 (1-2): points identified with little development.
